mapper.sql: id, project_id, preparation_type_code, business_version, current_marker, source_preparation_id, dynamic_form_instance_id, draft_marker, effective_marker, template_id, template_revision_id, template_snapshot, fixed_form_catalog_version, status_code, readiness_status_code, latest_readiness_snapshot_id, input_version, readiness_version, snapshot_current, content_version, completed_by, completed_at, submitted_at, confirmed_at, returned_at, return_reason, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sol_preparation ( id, project_id, preparation_type_code, business_version, current_marker, source_preparation_id, dynamic_form_instance_id, draft_marker, effective_marker, template_id, template_revision_id, template_snapshot, fixed_form_catalog_version, status_code, readiness_status_code, latest_readiness_snapshot_id, input_version, readiness_version, snapshot_current, content_version, completed_by, completed_at, submitted_at, confirmed_at, returned_at, return_reason, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id ) VALUES ( #{row.id}, #{row.projectId}, 'PRE_04_REQUIREMENT_ANALYSIS', #{row.businessVersion}, NULL, #{row.sourcePreparationId}, #{row.dynamicFormInstanceId}, 1, NULL, #{row.templateId}, #{row.templateRevisionId}, #{row.templateSnapshot}, 1, 'DRAFT', 'NOT_READY', NULL, 0, 0, 0, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, #{row.creator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{row.updater}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{row.tenantId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sol_preparation SET status_code = 'COMPLETED', draft_marker = NULL, effective_marker = 1, completed_by = #{update.completedBy}, completed_at = #{update.completedAt}, version = version + 1, updater = #{update.updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId} AND id = #{update.preparationId} AND preparation_type_code = 'PRE_04_REQUIREMENT_ANALYSIS' AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND draft_marker = 1 AND version = #{update.expectedVersion} AND content_version = #{update.expectedContentVersion}
